Half credit for mentioning at least the joy->sadness pivot. Zero if it says emotions were flat.

questions.judge_rubric: Full credit if the answer identifies Tag as Rachel's ASSISTANT AT WORK, and ideally also notes the relationship became personal/romantic (per the joy + anger + sadness mix of mentions). Half credit if only one dimension (just professional, or just romantic) is captured. Zero if Tag is described as e.g. a friend, family member, or stranger.
questions.question: Based on the enrolled conversations, what is the relationship between Rachel and Tag?
questions.ground_truth: Tag is Rachel's assistant at her workplace ('How would you feel about taking out my assistant Tag?', 'Tag, I have a conference call today'). The other mentions reveal the relationship also became personal — Rachel speaks of him with joy when things are good, anger during a fight, and sadness around 'Tag is not the father'. So: Rachel's professional assistant whom she also dated.
questions._tests: Entity description aggregation — the EntityResolver merges all Tag mentions into one node, and accumulated descriptions across 5 utterances should let the LLM infer the dual professional/romantic relationship.
